recall.question: Boxes are 20 cm tall and you want 3 cm above them for your hand. The shelf gap is 40 cm. How much height is wasted?
recall.why: The box and hand need 20 + 3 = 23 cm, so 40 − 23 = 17 cm is unused. Lowering the shelf further would take away the hand allowance. Shelf strength and mounting are outside this card.
